probe.text_sample: AutoRouter: Model router for Codex and Claude Code on Mac Product Subscriptions Routing and insights Models Privacy Mode Trust and data Apps Pricing For teams Resources Blog Updates Savings calculator Comparisons Plugin setup About AutoRouter New in 0.5.0 Introducing Privacy mode Sign in Keep coding when your AI plan hits its limit AutoRouter brings your Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions into the coding tools you already use. It picks the model for each turn and switches between connected plans automatically, so you can keep working in the same app. Your Claude and ChatGPT plans, working together in the coding apps you already use. AutoRouter picks a model and switches plans automatically. Balanced In order Take turns Make your plans last longer Even a $200 Max plan runs dry when every file read and rename hits your top model. AutoRouter sends mechanical tasks to fast models and spreads the rest across your Claude and ChatGPT plans.
